source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Examine each record carefully for any errors or omissions. 
3. Check to see if the correct tools were used and if the test was conducted properly. 
4. If errors are found, mark them as failed and document the reasons for failure.
5. Document any additional comments about the inspection. 
6. Be sure to include all relevant information in the report, such as the date of the inspection, the person who conducted the inspection, and the equipment used. 
7. Finally, sign and date the report. 
8. To make it even more thorough, you can also include a checklist of the items that were tested as well as a summary of the inspection findings.
